revision_basis.reason: Preserves the original revision-1 provenance fields consumed by the phase-1 fail-closed implementation.

alignment_revision_basis.reason: Frozen geometry diagnostics serialize WGS84 DEM bboxes to 8 decimals. Reusing those rounded bboxes can shift the reconstructed projected grid by millimetres, enough for a frozen outlet cell center to fall on the wrong side of the exact polygon mask. Revision 0.2 changes only deterministic raster alignment: it recovers the canonical 30 m grid origin from already-frozen outlet-cell row/column and center coordinates. The preferred source is the frozen geometry diagnostic; if a legacy diagnostic predates outlet_grid_cell, the already-frozen accepted_outlet registry cell is used. No basin polygon, outlet, DEM source tile, morphometry formula, D8 rule, slope rule or channel threshold is changed.

frozen_geometry_input.source: exact GitHub Actions geometry artifacts referenced by the outlet-freeze registry
frozen_geometry_input.verification: SHA256 of each downloaded GeoJSON must exactly equal geometry_geojson_sha256 in the frozen registry

dem_reconstruction.source_tile_integrity: every tile must already have an identical SHA256 in preregistered outlet evidence; unknown or conflicting tiles fail closed
dem_reconstruction.bbox_role: rounded frozen diagnostic bbox is used only to select/crop the same source tiles and obtain deterministic raster dimensions

anchor_source_order: legacy fallback: frozen outlet registry accepted_outlet cell
canonical_grid_alignment.anchor: frozen row/col and projected cell-center x/y for the already-selected outlet cell
canonical_grid_alignment.purpose: remove serialization-rounding drift without moving the frozen outlet or polygon

dem_reconstruction.semantic_fingerprint: SHA256 over canonical raster metadata and little-endian float32 cell values

cell_inclusion.polygon_metrics: project exact frozen polygon to EPSG:32718
cell_inclusion.raster_metrics: cell center inside polygon; rasterio all_touched=false
cell_inclusion.nodata: exclude non-finite or DEM nodata cells

hydrology.routing_integrity: at least 99.5 percent of frozen-polygon center cells must route to the frozen outlet
hydrology.drainage_density_threshold: contributing area >= 0.01 * exact frozen polygon planar area

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output hash is frozen
use the observed Cashahuacra metric values to tune any method
move an outlet or alter a basin polygon
change source tiles, slope algorithm, D8 method, channel threshold or cell-inclusion rule based on resulting values
discard a target because of unexpected morphometry
